name: gaspol-jobhunter
description: End-to-end job-hunting pipeline: discover roles from ATS APIs, boards and LinkedIn, score them against a runtime-supplied candidate profile, write a CV and cover letter for one specific job description, draft recruiter outreach as a Gmail draft or .eml fallback, and promote the roles worth pursuing into a self-hosted jobsync tracker over MCP. Never auto-applies and never submits a form. Nothing candidate-specific ships in the plugin; every personal value arrives at runtime from .jobhunter/config.toml in the user's own project.
